title: Vendor return lookup offers an inactive part with a grey Inactive tag
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test, with vendor A and 4 on hand, and set it inactive.
  • Create an active part, part B, for this test, with vendor A.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Create Return page (Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then the button that starts a new return).
custom_steps:
1. Pick vendor A in the Vendor field.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Part Number field.
  3. Click the part A row.
  4. Type 1 in Qty To Return.
  5. Type 10.00 in Price Per Unit.
  6. Click Save Return.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Vendor A is shown.

Step 2:

  • Parts A and B are offered.
  • Part A carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description; part B has no tag.

Step 3:

  • Part A fills the line with its description and its Qty In Stock, 4.

Step 4:

  • Qty To Return reads 1.

Step 5:

  • Price Per Unit reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The return saves with part A on it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R11: “Part lookup on a vendor return and on a vendor credit includes inactive parts.”
  • S9-R12: “In those lookups an inactive part carries a grey "Inactive" tag beside its description.”
  • Key Decisions: “Inactive parts stay out of new work, and stay in returns and credits. A retired part on a past sale still has to be returnable to the vendor and creditable to the customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "6.6 Vendor return: still offered, tagged". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.
